answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. The defense holds because trust accrues slowly and is lost fast, so a farm that ever submits a copied answer destroys the value of that identity. Consider a river as the anchor of the cost.
